jina-ai-search-reader.note: Keyless Reader at 20 RPM is lasting free usage (no expiry); the 10M tokens per new key are the one-time part. free_tier text already correct.

searchapi-io.free_tier: Trial: 100 free requests one-time on signup, no credit card required; then Developer plan $40/mo for 10,000 searches

serper.free_tier: Trial: 2,500 free queries one-time on signup, no credit card required; then prepaid query packages

you-com-api.free_tier: Free tier: Web Search API free without an API key at 100 queries/day; new accounts also get a $100 one-time credit on signup for Search, Contents, Answer and Research APIs
you-com-api.note: Pricing page lists a Free plan for the Web Search API, 100 queries/day, no API key required - a lasting daily quota; the $100 credit is the one-time part.

scrapingbee.free_tier: Trial: 1,000 free API credits one-time on signup, no card required; then Hobby plan $19/mo for 75,000 credits

zyte-api.free_tier: Trial: $5 free credit one-time on signup, valid 30 days, no subscription needed; then pay-as-you-go or a monthly commitment

creatomate-api.free_tier: Trial: full-featured trial with 50 credits one-time on signup, no credit card required; then Essential plan with 2,000 credits/mo

tavus-api.free_tier: Free tier: Free plan with 25 min of conversational video and 5 min of video generation per month, full API access, 25 stock replicas; Starter $59/mo

assemblyai-api.free_tier: Trial: $50 in free credits one-time on signup, no card required, credits do not expire (LLM Gateway not included); then pay-as-you-go

deepgram-api.free_tier: Trial: $200 in free credit one-time on signup, no credit card required; then pay-as-you-go

loudly-api.free_tier: Trial: free track allowance on signup with the API key from the developer portal; then volume-based pricing (Startup/SME/Corporate) or pay-as-you-go

meshy-api.free_tier: Paid only: creating API keys requires a paid plan (Pro $20/mo+); Free accounts get only a built-in test key for the Playground (free web plan 100 credits/mo)

v0-platform-api-vercel.free_tier: Free tier: v0 Free plan includes $5 of credits per month (7 messages/day); Platform API use on Free not confirmed, credits also included on Premium/Team plans

aws-textract.free_tier: Trial: new AWS customers get 3 months free, per month 1,000 pages DetectDocumentText, 100 pages AnalyzeDocument forms/tables/layout/queries, 100 AnalyzeExpense/AnalyzeID

reducto-api.free_tier: Trial: $150 in free credits (15,000 credits) one-time for new Standard accounts; then standard rates; Startup Program gives extra credits to qualifying teams

unstructured-api.free_tier: Trial: 10,000 free pages one-time on signup, no credit card; then pay-as-you-go at $0.015/page

daytona.free_tier: Trial: $200 free compute credit one-time on signup, no credit card required; first 5 GiB storage free; startup program up to $50k credits

zendesk-api.free_tier: Trial: 14-day free trial of Suite Professional, one-time; no free plan, paid plans from $19/agent/mo (Support Team, annual)

plaid-api.free_tier: Trial: Sandbox always free; new US/Canada teams (since 2026-04-15) get a free Trial plan with up to 10 Production Items one-time; then pay-as-you-go

pipedream-connect.free_tier: Free tier: free workspaces get a daily credit limit and limited connected accounts; Connect is free in development mode, production use needs a paid plan
